notes: Droppers, conveyors, collectors and buy-buttons make this a Simulation tycoon outright, and the four-tier weapon tree plus the PvP arena the answers add are enough for Action to be doing real work as a second genre rather than being a feature of the first. Shape is plot-isolated over the Tycoon preset's plot-shared because there are exactly six plots, each claimed by and assigned to one named player, not one plot a team shares - bent from the catalogue's "massive" to the small hideout-sized footprints the answers ask for, arranged around the compact hub. The preset's gate-progression covers the colour-themed upgrade buttons, walls and defensive barriers, social-hub the central spawn area, and path-circulation the spokes joining the six plots and the arena to it; from Action I took spawn-protected and cover-los for the arena, since the answers make plots protected income areas and put combat in a separate small arena connected to the hub. The arena is connected rather than instanced, so the whole thing is one continuous map on P0; its interior furniture was mine to decide with no user, and I kept it to anti-camp entry points and a few sightline breakers rather than inventing ring-out pits.
